## Summary
Tracks per-participant audio activity level for SFU audio processing. The package converts RTP audio levels into smoothed linear activity values and reports whether recent audio should be considered active.

## Responsibilities
- Define audio level activity, update interval, and smoothing configuration.
- Observe audio levels by explicit duration or RTP timestamp progression.
- Smooth observed audio levels and reset stale or completed observation windows.
- Convert audio level decibel values into linear values.
